newsitem.title: UK: Laporte climbs on Dresdner Kleinwort view.
newsitem.headline: Laporte climbs on Dresdner Kleinwort view.

text.p: Shares in Laporte Plc gained 14p to 660p on Thursday after Dresdner Kleinwort restated its positive view on the stock in an overall cautious research note on the sector, dealers said.
Analyst Jeremy Chantry said he expected Friday's Laporte yearly shareholders meeting to be positive.

He said the note was also positive on British Vita Plc, up 1/2p to 195-1/2p, based on its currency neutrality, Inspec Group Plc, unchanged at 205-1/2p, based on its debt reduction programme being on track and Courtaulds Plc, up 5p to 335-1/2p, after its yearly results on Wednesday.
Chantry changed his stance only on Courtaulds which he raised to "buy" from "hold".
